title: In 1972 a Rock Skipped Off Earth's Atmosphere Like a Stone on Water

scenes.text: In 1972 a space rock bounced off Earth's atmosphere and flew away.
It blazed across the daytime sky from Utah to Canada.
It came in at about 33,000 miles an hour.
It skimmed within 35 miles of the ground for about 100 seconds.
Then it skipped back out, like a stone across a lake.
Nobody has seen it since. It may be back.

description:
On August 10th, 1972, a rock skimmed through Earth's atmosphere in daylight, from Utah to Canada.
It came within about 35 miles of the ground, then bounced back into space and has never been found.
Would it ever come back?
first_comment: Would you have looked up to see it?
